header.title: Suppl. Mag. 10: Amulet for a man: against fever with shivering fits: AI translation (Claude)
header.author: Supplementum Magicum
header.source: Translated by Claude (claude-opus-5-5, Anthropic) from the library's urn:magic:dclp:64270:grc, from papyri.info's Digital Corpus of Literary Papyri (CC BY 3.0), one English line for each line of the original. Only some passages are translated so far: those that the Atlas of Ancient Myth, Magic in the Ancient Texts and the demons-and-angels study cite.
header.statement: An AI-generated translation. No specialist has reviewed it.
header.availability: CC BY 4.0: credit papyri.info's Digital Corpus of Literary Papyri (the source's own licence is CC BY 3.0) and this AI translation.

notes.1.1: Letters with a dot below are doubtful (Akr]ạmmachamari, Barphaṛ[an]gēs, aeẹ̄iouō, Ṛaphael, Ẹḷọai, ẹn). About five letters are lost after Phrē. Seme-/silam is the name Semesilam broken across lines, and quar-/tan one word. The end of the last line of the third section (ẹn...[..]ē) cannot be read or translated. ⟨ν⟩ in 'every other day' is the editor's supplement. Asterisks are kept as printed.

nodes.text: Seseng[e]r Barphaṛ[an]gēs * aeẹ̄iouō * Iaō Phrē[...] ēaō iaō eaō
protect Touthous, whom Sara bore, from
every shivering fit and fever, tertian, quar-
tan, daily, quotidian, or every other day; Ẹḷọai
